classified.text: Kintex Ultrascale+ FPGA shall support STANAG3350 / RGB / VGA, DVI, ARINC818 interfaces

Requirement ID: DP-XMC-5049-HRS-003; Requirement: A micro-controller USB based GUI application shall be developed. Using the GUI, the micro-controller peripherals such as SPI and I2C which are used for on-board external ICs shall be configured; Testing Plan: The test application shall be updated from the USB based GUI of DP-VPX-6005
Requirement ID: DP-XMC-5049-HRS-0016; Requirement: USB2.0; Testing Plan: NA

Requirement ID: DP-XMC-5049-HRS-005; Requirement: The supply current shall be measured by power analysis of module components; Testing Plan: NA
DP-XMC-5049-HRS-006 Power dissipation shall be measured by power analysis of module components
Requirement ID: DP-XMC-5049-HRS-007; Requirement: DDR4 full memory test shall be performed; Testing Plan: Refer DP- VPX-5792 test application
